sample_unit: real patient records in clinician gold-standard validation (plus 720 synthetic notes)

links.outcome: Extraction performance on adversarial synthetic notes with linguistic noise
links.effect: Synthetic stress-test: 87.2% accuracy, 73.9% sensitivity, 99.5% specificity, 99.2% PPV; real-world clinician validation sensitivity was 83.6%, so recall fell under noise while precision stayed high.
links.quote: In synthetic stress-testing, the pipeline demonstrated 87.2% accuracy (95% CI 84.6%-89.6%), 73.9% sensitivity (95% CI 68.9%-78.5%), near-perfect specificity (99.5%, 95% CI 98.1%-99.9%), and 99.2% PPV (95% CI 97.2%-99.9%).

unlisted_practices: Deploying a small open-weight language model on-premise behind the institutional firewall for privacy-preserving extraction
Hybrid small language model plus deterministic regular expression pipeline

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an on-premise pipeline (Phi4-mini plus regular expressions) for clinical information extraction from EHRs, but evaluates model performance rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
